title: O*NET Task Tool-Use Output Schema
description: Structured output schema for prompt template prompts/genq_from_onet_tasks.md.

tool_analysis.description: Analysis of how selected tools support the provided O*NET tasks.

cross_tool_workflow.description: Workflow across tools including dependencies and decision points.

target_tools.description: Ordered tool calls required to satisfy the request.

server.description: MCP server name that provides the tool.

tool.description: Tool name on the selected server.

arguments.description: Tool call arguments matching the tool input schema.

output.description: Expected output from executing the tool call.

request.description: Natural language user request grounded in the O*NET tasks.

withheld_info.description: Parameters deliberately omitted from the request that the agent must ask about.

parameter.description: Short name for the withheld parameter (e.g., 'account_id', 'date_range').

description.description: Why this parameter is needed and what tool(s) require it.

value.description: The actual value that should be supplied when the agent asks for it.

target_followup_questions.description: Clarifying questions the agent should ask to obtain the withheld parameters.
